Subject: Medicore compliance checklist & SOC2 Type II access

Hi Mira —

Thanks again for your time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Recap: high-level product fit looks good for your clinical triage workflows. Key security asks you called out: SOC 2 Type II evidence, HIPAA/BAA specifics, data residency, and a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) for your procurement team.
- What we can do now: provide our SOC 2 Type II executive summary, a bridge letter for the gap to the next audit window, and invite your team to our trust portal where we store reports and controls evidence.
- Next steps I suggest: (1) Rishi will share the SOC 2 summary + bridge letter, (2) we’ll invite your security and procurement contacts to the trust portal, (3) we’ll kick off the VSQ — redwood can complete the questionnaire and follow with a live kickoff to walk through answers if helpful.

Questions for you: who should I add to the trust portal (security + procurement contacts)? Also, does Medicore require a BAA before we share more detailed artifacts?

I’ve cc’d Rishi (Head of Security) and Monica (Customer Success) to own the artifact delivery and onboarding.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message; will follow with Rishi's message which includes the SOC2 summary and bridge letter stubs.

Alex — thanks for the summary and for looping others in. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: we need a copy of the most recent Type II report or an executive summary + bridge letter if full report access requires an NDA/BAA. Which is easier to share quickly?
2) HIPAA: Medicore processes PHI in some flows. Do you have an existing BAA template? We’ll need confirmation that Redwood supports HIPAA-covered work and an indication of where processing occurs (US regions only?).
3) VSQ: procurement will need to kick off the standard 120+ question VSQ. Can Redwood intake that in a questionnaire portal or do you prefer us to send it as an attachment?

Please add my security lead Kyle (cc’d) and our procurement mailbox to the trust portal invite. Kyle will be the primary security reviewer.

Thanks — Mira
Head of InfoSec
Medicore Health

Hi Mira/Kyle —

Thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front, then logistics: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood has a 2025 SOC 2 Type II report. For initial review we can provide an executive summary and a bridge letter today and grant portal access for secure download of the full report subject to a standard NDA/BAA. I’ve attached the executive summary (SOC2_TypeII_summary_2025.pdf) and a draft bridge letter (Bridge_Letter_20270319.pdf).

- HIPAA/BAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows. We maintain a BAA and are comfortable starting with a mutual nondisclosure if procurement prefers. If you want to review our standard BAA, we can route via DocuSign — please advise preferred contact for review/redline.

- Data residency: Hosted in US regions by default; we can discuss EU residency if needed for EU customers.

- VSQ intake: We can accept your VSQ via our secure questionnaire portal (preferred) — I’ll send a portal invite which will pre-fill our controls where possible to reduce duplication. Alternative: you can email the questionnaire and we’ll respond on the doc.

Portal invite (one-time use): https://trust.redwood.com/invite/ABC123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9843

Attachments included: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2025.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB stub), Bridge_Letter_20270319.pdf (pdf, 12KB stub)

- Alex/Monica: schedule a 30-min VSQ kickoff with procurement + security to walk through scope (we recommend Tue/Wed next week).
